short_description: A broadcast + streaming network's premium Live Sports inventory is being sold at run-of-network prices after an ad-server migration, while four fall upfronts pace toward make-goods. ai_forecast projects avails, gold tables track pacing, spare in-target avails and eCPM vs rate card, and the Ad Yield Copilot app (Databricks App on Lakebase) builds a recovery plan with live lakehouse SQL and the Genie agent over the rate card, floor policy, make-good policy and IO terms — rebalancing the under-delivering IO onto the mis-priced premium inventory, restoring its floor and writing the plan back; the SVP Ad Revenue tracks yield in an AI/BI dashboard and Genie.
